finalFairy.prompt: Background extraction edit ONLY. Keep the fairy illustration exactly identical, every pixel of the character design, wings, pose, face location, framing and size unchanged. Remove ALL of the surrounding painted gray/lavender/white atmospheric haze, cloudy backdrop, rectangular background and glow. The output must be a clean isolated fairy cutout PNG with true alpha transparency: every pixel outside the actual fairy, hair, dress and wings must be fully transparent (alpha zero), including the upper corners and spaces between arms and torso. Do not leave a gray translucent rectangle behind the fairy. Preserve the delicate transparent wing membrane, full wings and fine hair silhouette. No other changes. This sprite will be composited directly over a very dark forest so any residual backdrop will show as an unwanted rectangle.
